confirmedIssues: The shipped default execution lane still uses the integrated workspace payload from `apps/platform/server/services/processes/environment/script-execution.service.ts`, which emits `archiveEntries: []` and only a synthetic finalized `process_event`; because `apps/platform/server/app.ts` wires that service by default and `apps/platform/server/services/archive/process-history-compat.service.ts` only bridges legacy history kinds, real production runs still do not generate low-level `reasoning`, `script_emission`, `tool_call`, or `tool_result` archive entries without a custom injected runner.

Archive read-time provenance enrichment can still falsely degrade older archive rows: `apps/platform/server/services/archive/archive-entry-enrichment.ts` resolves source provenance from `listProcessSourceProvenance`, but `convex/sourceProvenance.ts` only loads the newest 200 provenance records for a process, so archive entries linked to older provenance IDs can be treated as missing context even when the provenance row still exists.
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: Earlier verifier findings about deferred archive appends, stale turn/view caches, and missing derived-view pagination are not supported by the current code: deferred entries are appended immediately and later patched, archive append/patch invalidates cached turns/views, derived-view responses are cursor-paginated, and `corepack pnpm run verify-all` now passes.
The process work-surface still does not expose an obvious archive navigation control, but the epic artifacts reviewed here do not make that a clear closeout blocker.
result.readinessAssessment: Epic 7 is not ready for closeout yet. The epic gate now passes (`corepack pnpm run verify-all`), but the current implementation still has a real production-path archive gap in the default execution lane and a remaining provenance-enrichment correctness bug for long histories. Separately, `corepack pnpm run green-verify` is not green in the current workspace because `guard:no-test-changes` fails against `HEAD`.
result.recommendedNextStep: Replace or override the default integrated runtime payload with a process-specific execution producer that emits real canonical archive entries on the live path, fix source-provenance enrichment so archive-linked provenance can be resolved beyond the latest 200 rows, then rerun `corepack pnpm run green-verify` and `corepack pnpm run verify-all`.
